function.name: add_item
function.description: Add one menu line to the order. Call once per distinct menu line. Only pass options the customer actually asked for (or that a slang alias implies); omitted options use the defaults.

shots_delta.description: Extra (+) or fewer (-) espresso shots relative to the standard recipe, in steps of 0.5 (half shot). e.g. 1 = one extra shot, 0.5 = half a shot extra, -0.5 = half a shot fewer. Default 0.

sweetness.description: Sweetness level (lattes, teas, ades only). Default normal.

function.name: modify_item
function.description: Change options of an item already in the current order.

item_index.description: 1-based line number in the current order.

shots_delta.description: New shot adjustment, in steps of 0.5.

function.name: remove_item
function.description: Remove an item from the current order.

item_index.description: 1-based line number in the current order.

function.name: ask_clarification
function.description: Say something to the customer instead of acting: ask what they mean, or politely decline. Use when the request is ambiguous, breaks a menu rule, or asks for something the cafe does not offer.

question.description: What to say to the customer, in Korean.

reason.description: ambiguous = unclear what or which item; impossible = an existing option that this item cannot take (e.g. hot ade, syrup on coffee); off_menu = an item or option the cafe does not offer at all (e.g. a drink not on the menu, decaf, whipped cream).

function.name: call_staff
function.description: Hand over to a human staff member for things the robot must not decide: preparation status of an order already placed, time promises (pickup/delivery), bulk-order timing, carriers/bags, ice cups, and other service requests that are not menu orders.

reason.description: Short Korean note for the staff member describing the request.

function.name: confirm_order
function.description: The customer has finished ordering; confirm and place the current order.

dine_option.description: takeout if the customer said so at any point in the conversation (포장, 테이크아웃, 가져갈게요 ...), otherwise dine_in (default).
